overview: A generic System.Text.Json converter factory for Optional<T>, reflection/Activator-based converter construction, token reading/writing and the semantic difference between a missing property and an explicit JSON null.

regions.summary: Why a JsonConverterFactory is needed for open generic Optional<T>; Optional<T> state model; Activator.CreateInstance vs ConstructorInfo.Invoke; factory CanConvert/CreateConverter; registration; reader/token flow and converter Read/Write skeleton.

Missing property vs present null vs present value; default(Optional<T>); serializer behavior when converter is not called; Optional<T>.IsSet semantics; writer behavior and limitations around omitting properties.
